## Generative and world models under finite compute

I study generative and world models under finite compute, with a focus on
rigorous evaluation, numerical behavior, and downstream decision-making.

I am completing the Engineering Degree at CentraleSupélec, specializing in
Mathematics and Data Science, alongside the Research Master's in Mathematics
and Artificial Intelligence at Université Paris-Saclay. I also work as a
Generative AI Engineer at MBDA on multi-agent systems built around large
language models, after working as a Data Scientist at TotalEnergies' Digital
Factory.

[Explore the research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Selected research

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
### Few-Step Field Regularity

**Problem.** When a probability-flow ODE is solved with only a few function
evaluations, does a smoother velocity field imply a smaller sampling error?

**Result.** An exact one-dimensional Gaussian construction reverses the
regularity and Heun error orderings at eight function evaluations; the broader
finite benchmark contains both agreements and disagreements.

**Status.** Research manuscript and reproducible software.

[Code](https://github.com/clement-callaert/fewstep-field-regularity) ·
[Manuscript](https://github.com/clement-callaert/fewstep-field-regularity/blob/main/paper/arxiv/main.pdf)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Ego-World JEPA

**Problem.** Can a factored latent world model make model-predictive control
more effective on PushT?

**Result.** Strong in-slice state decodability did not produce a robust
planning benefit: the apparent seed-0 factorization gap disappeared on the
second seed.

**Status.** Completed controlled project with a negative result.

[Code and results](https://github.com/clement-callaert/ego-world-sub-jepa)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Adaptive Latent Search

**Problem.** Can a learned stop-or-continue controller allocate latent-search
compute better than fixed budgets and simple diagnostics?

**Result.** In a small `pattern_2d` sandbox, the learned policy did not beat a
gradient-norm stopping rule, despite an oracle gap that left room for adaptive
allocation.

**Status.** Exploratory extension of LPN; no ARC-AGI claim.

[Research branch](https://github.com/clement-callaert/lpn/tree/research/stochastic-latent-search) ·
[Report](https://github.com/clement-callaert/lpn/blob/research/stochastic-latent-search/report/main.pdf)
:::
:::

## Working principles

The projects on this site follow a simple standard: make the hypothesis
testable, use controlled protocols and strong baselines, keep negative results,
and state exactly where the evidence stops. Detailed questions, methods,
limitations, and artifacts are collected on the [Research page](research.qmd).
